pick.name: Canva Free
pick.what: Template-driven design for one-pagers and decks
pick.why: Huge template library, PDF export, commercial use per Canva licence (secondary)
pick.free_limits: Free: templates, 5 GB, 1 brand kit; Pro about USD 144/yr

best_free.name: LibreOffice Impress
best_free.what: Free desktop presentation editor, exports PDF
best_free.why: Free, open-source (MPL-2.0) offline editor that reads and writes PPTX; no per-seat cost and no commercial restriction

alts.name: Claude document skills (pptx/docx/pdf)
alts.why: Best for data-heavy documents; requires a paid Claude plan or API

decision: Draft copy with an LLM (problem, solution, numbers, quote), then use Canva templates for polish; use generated PPTX when a buyer wants an editable deck.
